# Tech Faculty NG

> Licensed Nigerian tech training institute in Nnewi, Anambra State. Bootcamps in software engineering, AI, data science, cybersecurity, design, and digital marketing — with certification and job placement support.

Tech Faculty NG trains, certifies, and employs the next generation of African tech talent. Programs run online, hybrid, or on-site, with a free foundation bootcamp and modular paid tracks billed in NGN or USD. The platform also offers SIWES industrial training, a software product portfolio, a tech store, and a certificate verification portal.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of bootcamps, learning modes, pricing, and outcomes.
- [About](/about): Mission, history, licensing, and team behind Tech Faculty NG.
- [Business Partnerships](/business-partnerships): Hire-from / train-with-us programs for companies.
- [School Collaborations](/school-collaborations): Bootcamp partnerships for universities and secondary schools.
- [SIWES](/siwes): Industrial training placement (Learn & Pay, Tutor & Earn tracks).
- [Events](/events): Workshops, hackathons, and community sessions.
- [Careers](/careers): Internal job board and open roles at Tech Faculty NG.
- [Software Products](/products): Apps and platforms built by Tech Faculty including Dear Claire, Alter Ego, PalmShop.ng, Tiny People AI.
- [Tiny People AI](/tinypeople): Messaging-native AI agent built with Natura Inc.
- [Tech Store](/tech-store): Laptops, gadgets, and learning gear with Faculty ID member discounts.
- [Verify Certificate](/verify): Public certificate verification portal.
- [Blog](/blog): Tech careers, bootcamp guides, and industry insights for Nigeria.
